count_method: by eye on 1.0x crops; these smooth joined signs (sweeps that run into each other, hooks, S-curves) are hard to separate, count +-3. The segmenter classes 70v l.11 as Arabic (no count).
style: a new cursive family: smooth connected sweeps and hooks like distorted Arabic letter forms (ha-curve, S-hook, b-loop, d-hook, long sin, heart-shaped loop, triangle, 8-loop); dividers a stroke with three dots
technique_note: 70v l.8-10: وكتبت له بيتين قد بين [?] للمارهين [?] من المهملات / التي ذكرتها في كتاب العروض المجملة في المجموعة / والمهملة ولكن غيرت منهما لفظتين لنكر اداة التعريف ('I wrote him two verses in one of the muhmal (unused) metres that I set out in the book of prosody, ... but I changed two words in them to avoid the article'); after it 71r l.4: فحله سريعا وارسله وهو ('he solved it quickly and sent it, and it is'); 71r l.7: وهو في الاصل لا تدن من الخيام تقل غيرتها ('in the original it is: لا تدن من الخيام تقل غيرتها' - the unchanged wording with the article). NB: المهملات here are the unused metres of the prosody book, not undotted letters: the verses contain dotted letters (قلت, بنجد, تتبع ...), so this is not a lipogram.

plaintext.text: كم قلت لصاحبي بنجد لا تتبع حبا [?] مهم [?] فتقتل / فهارشا [?] اذا انثنى من قامته الغصون تخجل
plaintext.certainty: medium (حبا مهم and فهارشا doubtful)

fit_check: fits within the count's margin: about 65 signs (+-3) vs 63 letters; 16 groups = 16 words. Group check only at the end: الغصون 2 + 4 over the line end (71r l.2-3), تخجل as 2 + 2 (a divider-like mark inside). Not checked word by word.
notes: 71r l.7 (the original wording) is not part of the enciphered pair. Draft's counts (17, 14, 16 / 18, 20, 15) were far too high.

pages.note: plaintext: Ibn al-Wardi's couplet as written, with the encipherer's substitution stated at 72r l.9-10

count_method: by eye on a 1.0x crop of 71r l.10-12 (small hooked signs, some with a dot below; count +-2)
style: hooked 'r/z'-like signs with a dot below or beside, 4-loop (the most frequent: ya), triangle pair, Y on a bar, boxed bar, slanted double bar, small circle, b-loop, 2-hook, omega; dividers a stroke with three dots
technique_note: intro 71r l.7-9: وكتب لي / امين الدين عبد الوهاب بن روهبان [?] المزي الحنفي قاضي حماه / اليوم المقدم ذكره ('and Amin al-Din Abd al-Wahhab b. Ruhban [?] al-Mizzi al-Hanafi, today qadi of Hama, mentioned above, wrote to me'); after it l.13: فحللته وكتبت تحته هذه بضاعتنا ردت الينا ('I solved it and wrote under it: this is our merchandise returned to us', Q 12:65); 71v l.1-7 and 72r l.1-11 explain: the master solved it too but understood the quotation only later; the conceit (the water-wheel that once watered and sang and now is watered and wails) was the compiler's, which he had told Zayn al-Din Umar b. al-Wardi in Aleppo; Ibn al-Wardi said the two verses were his own; 72r l.9-11: لكنه استعمل انه / مكان حالة من بيتي زين الدين لاجل الجناس ليصعب حلها / فعرفه انني حللتها بما كتبته تحتها ('but he [Amin al-Din] used انه in place of حالة in Zayn al-Din's two verses, for the paronomasia, to make it hard to solve; so he knew I had solved it from what I wrote under it')

plaintext.text: حالة الدولاب دلت انه في فرط حزن / كان يسقي ويغني صار يسقى ويغني
plaintext.folio_lines: 72r l.4-5 (cipher form: انه in place of حالة, per 72r l.9-10)
plaintext.certainty: medium (the enciphered wording is reconstructed from the written couplet plus the stated substitution; not written out in that form)

fit_check: fits: 48 signs vs 48 letters in the cipher form (انه الدولاب دلت انه في فرط حزن / كان يسقي ويغني صار يسقى ويغني); the written form with حالة has 49. 15 groups vs 13 words; group lengths not matched one by one (the first groups read 2, 6, 4 against انه, الدولاب, دلت), so the word-level fit is not established, only the total. The same 4-sign group (4-loop, Y-bar, triangle pair, 4-loop = يغني) occurs twice, as يغني does.
notes: 71v l.8-13 give the compiler's own longer version (كنت غصنا في الدوح ... / انه الدولاب دلنا انه مفرط الوجد وبالدمع يبوح / كان يسقي ويغني زمنا صار يسقى ويغني وينوح); at 70 letters it does not fit this block (48 signs). 71v has no cipher.

count_method: by eye on 1.0x crops and a 1.6x crop of 72r l.13 left; the segmenter loses signs on 72r l.12-13 (a worm track crosses both lines and it merges the double-loop and slash signs); 72v agrees
style: hooked-loop alphabet: 6-shaped hooked loop (= alif, the most frequent), 4-arrow, ra-hook, 8-loop (= za), slash with a dot, double loop, U, box open on the left, Pi, T, inverted-A, b with a dot, sweeps; dividers a stroke with three dots
technique_note: intro 72r l.11: ... وكتبت للمشار اليه دام ظله ('and I wrote for the aforementioned, may his shade endure'); after it 72v l.4-5: هذان البيتان نظمتهما فيه ارتجالا وترجمتهما له فحلهما / وارسلهما وهما ('these two verses I composed about him extempore and enciphered (tarjamtuhuma) for him; he solved them and sent them, and they are')

plaintext.text: يا مسعدي رقمك زهر ونثر الدر ما فهمت به لا لفظا / ما ذل من كنت له ناصرا او ضاع من كنت له حافظا
plaintext.certainty: high (a gap is left before لفظا in l.6)

fit_check: fits: 67 signs vs 69 letters; about 23 groups = 23 words. Second verse and the end of the first checked group by group: لفظا 4, ما 2, ذل 2, من 2, كنت 3, له 2 (over the line end), ناصرا 5, او 2, ضاع 3, من 2, كنت 3 (over the line end), له 2, حافظا 5; the hooked loop is alif in every one of them (ناصرا twice, حافظا twice, او, ضاع, ما), 8-loop = za in لفظا and حافظا. The first verse's opening groups on 72r are not checked one by one (two signs short there overall).
notes: A worm track crosses the middle of 72r l.12-13.

pages.note: plaintext, after the solver's remark on 73r l.1

count_method: by eye on 1.25x half crops; segmenter one more on l.9 (a worm hole); every group checked against the words
style: angular alphabet: H (= alif, very frequent), =H (= lam), inverted V with a bar (= ya), inverted triangle on a bar (= jim), Y-bar ta-hook (= waw), S/kaf-hook (= mim), 6-loop (= ha), triangle on a bar (= qaf), sin-sweep (= kaf), barred loop, ^ with a dot (= ra), loop+hook 'er'; dividers a stroke with three dots
technique_note: intro 72v l.8: ثم كتب لي عظم الله شانه وارسله الي ('then he wrote to me and sent it to me'); after it 73r l.1: فحللتها سريعا مع صعوبتها غير الغين فانه تعسر والثا وهما ('I solved it quickly despite its difficulty, except the ghayn, which was hard, and the tha; and they are'); 73r l.4: ولعمري انه هو كذلك ('by my life, he is indeed so')

plaintext.text: غيث جود مني [?] وغوث جود كم حمى لاجيا واحيا عديما / فهو ذخر لقاصديه وفخر ظاعنا كان دهره او مقيما
plaintext.certainty: high (مني written ميي-like)

fit_check: fits: 72 signs = 72 letters; 21 groups vs 19 words. Group by group: غيث 3, جود 3, مني 3, وغوث 4, then a lone sign (kaf-hook) at the end of l.9 before جود 3 at the start of l.10 (a surplus sign, perhaps a false start of جود), كم 2, حمى 3, لاجيا 5, واحيا 1 + 3 over the line end (one short), عديما 5, فهو 3, ذخر 3, لقاصديه 7, وفخر 4, ظاعنا 5, كان 3, دهره 4, او 2, مقيما 5. Consistent values: H = alif (لاجيا, عديما, ظاعنا, كان, او, مقيما), inverted V = ya (مني, حمى, لاجيا, عديما, مقيما), =H = lam, ^. = ra (ذخر, وفخر, دهره), 6-loop = ha (دهره twice, لقاصديه).
notes: The chain starts at the foot of 72v (l.9-13); its plaintext is on 73r (image 150). A small catchword-like word in the lower left corner of 72v (فحللتها?), the first word of 73r.
